articles.title: Review – Absolute Green Lantern #11: Red With Rage
articles.summary: This article reviews 'Absolute Green Lantern #11', giving it a perfect 10/10 rating. It highlights how the comic successfully portrays the terrifying aspects of space, a nuanced approach compared to the franchise's typical cosmic adventures. The review suggests a compelling blend of fright and the established Green Lantern universe, offering a deep, adventurous read for comic enthusiasts.

articles.title: Reading scores are falling in the US: Why boys are losing ground faster than girls in class
articles.summary: Reading scores across the United States are declining significantly, revealing a concerning trend where boys are losing ground faster than girls in classroom performance. This educational disparity highlights a growing gender gap in literacy and academic achievement. The underlying causes of this rapid decline for boys, relative to girls, warrant further examination into teaching methodologies and societal factors impacting learning.

articles.title: Consumer Electronics Market Size to Reach USD 1,949 Billion by 2035

articles.title: Meet the 2026 Mariners NRIs

articles.title: Global partners advance plans to harden submarine cable networks

articles.title: India Data Center Market to Reach Over US$ 31.36 Billion by 2035 Driven by Generative AI, 5G Rollout, and Cloud Infrastructure Growth | Astute Analytica
articles.summary: India's data center market is projected for robust growth, valued at US$ 8.94 billion in 2025 and expected to reach US$ 31.36 billion by 2035, exhibiting a significant CAGR of 13.37%. This expansion highlights India's accelerating digital transformation, increasing demand for data infrastructure, and its growing importance as a global data hub, vital for national economic and technological progress.

articles.title: 40 Little-Known Moments In History You Won’t Find In Textbooks
articles.summary: Vintage photos possess a unique magnetic quality, freezing authentic moments in time. They expertly capture everyday life, significant historical events, and subtle details often overlooked by traditional history books. Their appeal lies in preserving genuine slices of the past, offering a visual window into bygone eras for enthusiasts and historians alike.
